summary: Footnote qualifies 'we avoid training against our monitors', citing early-RL reward-hacking penalty over thoughts (Sec. 3.4.5.2); eval-awareness rates revised; 'mitigated as if at CCL' dropped.
notable: Without a revision note, the Gemini 4 Argon safety report qualified its claim that it avoids training against chain-of-thought monitors by pointing to an already-disclosed reward-hacking penalty that saw the model's thoughts, revised its evaluation-awareness rates, and deleted the sentence 'We mitigated as if at CCL regardless' from a CBRN section.
